_doc: LUC3D-JS-CONSISTENCY-PLAN-2026-10-20 G1/G2. Every input the final build reads, keyed by the FILE it resolves to (out/ relative), with its kind. Kinds that must carry lucid_commit = v1.0.5: luc3d_js, app_capture. 'unclassified' fails the gate on purpose until someone checks it. python_geometry_allowlist: every script on the build path that triangulates / projects / undistorts in Python, with why that is not LUC3D work.

fig2-protocol.json.reason: Playwright capture of the eric/figs app, Aug 25 (fig2_protocol.mjs). Eric D4 2026-10-20: keep. Not v1.0.5, so the caption must not imply it.

fig2a_scene.json.reason: arena/floor placement for a render (fig2a_scene.py via hardfight_common). Display only; J5 decides whether it shows LUC3D output.

fig2g_retime_all_jsb.json.reason: J16b sitting: fig2_solvers_time_luc3d.mjs on v1.0.5; Anipose arms are the baseline.

fig4_robust_sessions_js.json.reason: fig2_solvers_robust_sessions.mjs; drop rule is an analysis protocol (Methods).

fig5_upright.json.reason: statistics on the dataset's reference 3D (Eric: Fig 5 presents the dataset).

fig4_recovery_proofread2d.json.reason: counts of cameras carrying proofread 2D; no triangulation.

fig6_detections.json.reason: loaded by the Fig 4 build; panel use not yet verified.

fig6_detections_proofread_notail.json.reason: |label - reference reprojection| on the dataset's sleap-anipose 3D. Unplotted NumPy triage fields (J9) must not be cited.

fig6_recovery.json.reason: loaded by the Fig 4 build; generator and panel not yet verified.

fig7_calibration.json.reason: calibrat3 (separate repo) vs Anipose, scored by aniposelib.

fig3_exhaustive_bmimica_b3.json.reason: exhaustive enumeration (Maree et al.) baseline; reuses v1.0.5 triangulation.

fig3_frame_matched_bmimica_b3.json.reason: frame-matched rule; greedy arm is v1.0.5.

fig3_headtohead_b3.json.reason: greedy arm via fig3_bench.mjs (run_B3Q.sh asserts 2dc001fe); stamp added by J12.

fig3_sweep50__distanceThreshold25-stale2.reason: rescoring of the md56 sweep caches.

fig3_trackers.json.reason: read by the non-variant within-vs-cross panel that the build removes; not in any placed panel.

fig7_variant_best_c6b3.json.reason: LUC3D arm from fig8_methods_50_b3 (v1.0.5); metadata fixed by J11.

stale_sweep_slap2m.json.reason: read directly by panels/fig6slapstale_reduction.py; fig3_bench.mjs on v1.0.5.

../fig10-bench/results_v105/agg.reason: s-DANNCE via fig10_bench.mjs; run_SDV105.sh asserts 2dc001fe. The placed fig6c read results/agg (c9b2a325, eric-mimic2 S1); the final build sets FIG6_SDANNCE_AGG to this directory.

python_geometry_allowlist.fig7_calib_gt_compare.py: calibration benchmark against a synthetic rig.
